meta.title: PrimeNex IT — Dynamics 365, Salesforce and ERP consulting
meta.description: ERP and CRM consulting from Cartago, Costa Rica. Microsoft Dynamics 365 (F&O, Business Central, Customer Engagement), Salesforce Service Cloud, Oracle NetSuite, and the finance and supply chain processes that run on them.
meta.ogDescription: Dynamics 365, Salesforce and NetSuite implementation, support and integration — with real finance and supply chain process depth. Nearshore from Costa Rica.
meta.tagline: ERP and CRM consulting for finance and supply chain

hero.headline: We engineer the systems your business runs on.
hero.lede: We implement, support and integrate the business systems your operation depends on — Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce and NetSuite — and we know the processes that run on them, from purchase requisition through to inventory posting.

statement.label: What we actually do
statement.body: Most ERP problems are not software problems. They are a configuration, a business process, a security role, a piece of master data or an integration — and telling those apart is the work. We sit in the analyst seat: reproducing the reported issue, isolating the root cause, writing the functional and technical specification, and staying with the developers and the vendor until the fix ships.

services.label: Services
services.title: What we build and run for you
services.lede: Four practices, built around the systems that carry finance, supply chain and customer service — and around the processes that run inside them.

groups.headline: The Microsoft ecosystem, from rollout to hypercare
groups.blurb: Four implementations delivered across Finance & Operations, Business Central and Customer Engagement.

items.title: Implementation and rollout
items.body: Requirements gathering and fit-gap analysis, process mapping, security architecture covering roles, duties, privileges and segregation of duties, test scripts and UAT coordination, then release and environment management through to go-live.

items.title: Functional and technical support
items.body: Incident intake, triage and prioritisation, with layered root-cause analysis that separates configuration from business process, security, data, integration and environment — then escalation to Microsoft partners with reproduction steps and evidence when the fix sits outside our scope.

items.title: Extensions and customization
items.body: AL and X++ extensions, .NET and REST APIs where standard functionality leaves a gap, and a standard-versus-customization evaluation before anything gets written — because every customization is a cost you carry at every upgrade.

groups.headline: Service Cloud, declarative where it can be and coded where it must be
groups.blurb: Full Service Cloud implementations, from requirements elicitation through to training and handover.

items.title: Service Cloud implementation
items.body: Requirements elicitation with stakeholders, current-state process mapping and gap analysis, data model and business process configuration, member data migration with deduplication and integrity validation, and user role and profile design.

items.title: Declarative and programmatic build
items.body: Flow Builder and Lightning Web Components for the interfaces people use, and Apex for the business logic that declarative limits cannot reach. The line between the two is a decision, not an accident.

items.title: Omni-Channel and conversational assistants
items.body: Omni-Channel routing so cases reach the right agent, and conversational assistants built with Einstein Bots to handle first-line enquiries and deflect cases before an agent is needed.

groups.headline: The processes underneath the software
groups.blurb: Oracle NetSuite owned end to end across the finance and supply chain footprint, in the analyst seat rather than beside it.

items.title: ERP implementation
items.body: Full NetSuite rollout across Finance and Supply Chain: AS-IS and TO-BE process maps, gap analysis, functional specifications reconciled against standard functionality, roles and permissions under least privilege with segregation of duties, cutover planning and post-go-live hypercare.

items.title: Finance and supply chain process design
items.body: General ledger, accounts payable and receivable, accounting adjustments, posting setup and dimensions — and the procurement chain end to end: purchase requisition to purchase order to goods receipt to vendor invoice to inventory posting, with item and vendor master data.

items.title: Business process analysis
items.body: Requirements workshops with finance, procurement, inventory and operations stakeholders, then translation into functional and technical specifications developers and external vendors can actually build from. Plus UAT coordination, user training and process documentation.

groups.headline: Making separate systems behave like one
groups.blurb: Integrations between platforms that were never designed to talk, and the data work that decides whether anyone trusts the result.

items.title: Integrations and APIs
items.body: REST and SOAP integrations and event-driven APIs, including omnichannel integrations between Dynamics 365 and contact centre platforms — covering authentication, payload mapping and error handling across the CRM, telephony and integration layers.

items.title: Data migration and integrity
items.body: Migration with cleansing, deduplication and integrity validation, with full audit trails. SQL Server and Azure SQL, Oracle and MySQL, with ETL pipelines built to be re-run rather than performed once by hand.

items.title: Reporting and business intelligence
items.body: Power BI dashboards and SQL data models that answer the questions finance and operations actually ask, built on validated data — including predictive analytics that identify equipment bottlenecks before failure.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.title: What sits on the bench
capabilities.lede: Platform depth and the technical layer underneath it. The analyst work and the engineering work sit together here, which is why root cause gets found instead of escalated.

about.label: About us
about.title: A partner, not a vendor
about.mission: At PrimeNex IT, we empower businesses with advanced technological solutions focused on digital transformation. We provide training and IT support, covering software, hardware, embedded systems, and database and CRM management. We are committed to being a reliable partner that helps overcome technological challenges and maintain competitiveness.
about.vision: To be the leading strategic partner in technology and IT training, driving digital transformation. We aspire to lead innovation and set new standards of quality and service, helping our clients reach their full potential in a digital world.
about.objectivesLede: Five commitments we hold ourselves to, and that you are welcome to hold us to as well.

objectives.title: Lead digital transformation
objectives.body: Become the primary strategic partner for our clients in their digital transformation processes, providing innovative and customized solutions that optimize their operations.

objectives.title: Excellence in development and support
objectives.body: Maintain an exceptional standard of quality across software development, embedded systems, UX/UI, and database and CRM support, ensuring total customer satisfaction.

objectives.title: Continuous innovation

objectives.title: Market expansion

objectives.title: Sustainability and social responsibility
